input.evidence: permissions: write-all on line 12 of write-all-permissions.yml
input.recommendation: Follow the principle of least privilege by specifying only the exact permissions needed for the workflow.

input.evidence: Workflows issue-labeler.yml, no-permissions-declared.yml, pr-comment-handler.yml, pr-title-injection.yml, prt-dangerous-checkout.yml, self-hosted-runner.yml, and unpinned-actions.yml lack a permissions block.
input.recommendation: Add an explicit permissions block (e.g. permissions: contents: read) to all workflow files following the principle of least privilege.

input.description: Command injection via expression interpolation of untrusted event payloads in run scripts
input.evidence: echo "New issue opened: ${{ github.event.issue.title }}" on line 18 of issue-labeler.yml (similar pattern in pr-comment-handler.yml and pr-title-injection.yml)
input.recommendation: Pass untrusted event data via environment variables instead of direct expression interpolation in shell commands.

input.description: Dangerous pull_request_target checkout of untrusted pull request code
input.recommendation: Avoid checking out and executing untrusted PR code in workflows triggered by pull_request_target. Use pull_request instead.
input.evidence: pull_request_target trigger combined with actions/checkout@v3 checking out ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.ref }} on lines 17-20 of prt-dangerous-checkout.yml

input.recommendation: Do not automate pull request merging or approvals based on untrusted external triggers or pull_request_target.
